parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description:
The name of the file.

> The file name must end with .txt or .sql. For example, the file name can be text.txt.

parameters.name: FileSource
parameters.description:
The purpose of the file upload task. Valid values:

*   **datacorrect**: The file is uploaded to change data.
*   **order_info_attachment**: The file is uploaded as an attachment in a ticket.
*   **big-file**: The file is uploaded to import multiple data records at a time.
*   **sqlreview**: The file is uploaded for SQL review.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the [Manage DMS tenants](~~181330~~) topic.

parameters.name: UploadTarget
parameters.description: The information about the OSS file to be uploaded.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-upload-oss-file-job --file-source datacorrect --file-name test.sql --upload-target BucketName=test_bucket Endpoint=http://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com ObjectName=test.sql --tid 1 --region cn-hangzhou
